frames: Unreal cm, Z up. A station's frame: its origin is the station point on its floor (world X, Y, FloorAt), with the world's axes. The hero works from -X, facing +X.
view_contract: SoraWorkshopCraftRules::FView via FSoraKitView::LanternCraft: Active, RecipeComplete, Assist, Step, Committed[6], HeldStep, HeldMs, FailedStripSerial, FailedStripAgeMs, LastAction (Serial, Step, Unit, AgeMs; AgeMs saturates at ActionPresentationMs 1200)

states_all.shows: every station in its finished state and all 40 slots filled
every station at its start; the suggested 24 craftspeople's lanterns

collision: every mesh is visual only; root keeps or replaces its boxes with the proposed proxies. Each proxy is under the standing station trace's 88 cm start, so no standing ray meets one. That covers the standing capsule only: crouched (half-height 44) the trace starts at 44 cm, and proxy tops of 75-78 cm can block close crouched approaches, as today's generic benches can. Crouched and native coverage are root's

lantern.form_yaw: wind_deg * (Committed[0] + FLEX_STAGES[flex_stage(HeldMs)]) while bending, else wind_deg * Committed[0]
lantern.pivot: its centre (lantern frame); at the rib form and paste bench it sits at the station point

camera.note: a CPU geometric estimate of framing from the standing eye; it does not establish Unreal framing, materials or hand contact

gauge.needle: points along (0, sin a, cos a) in the station frame, a = gauge_angle(ms)

work_stand.note: the craft stand: the capsule 1 cm clear of the proxy's front (b09_craft_poses.py)

states.shows: SM_B09_RibForm and SM_B09_Hoop1..n, in the form's frame, at LanternCentre, turned by form_yaw_deg(n, 0)

one-ended winding: hoop n+1's strip, hooked in its notch, at flex_stage(HeldMs) (SM_B09_Hoop{n+1}_Flex000..075, then Hoop{n+1}), and the form turned by form_yaw_deg(n, flex), so the strip leaves at the front for the paws (WindPress, WindGuide); the needle along gauge_angle(HeldMs)
the needle at rest (gauge_angle(0), -90 deg); no strip on the form
SM_B09_SplitStrip at SplitStripRest while FailedStripAgeMs < 1200 (suggested), then a fresh strip; a new press clears it (root's -1)
the same gauge; the strip completes at 800 ms (the rules' assist pass)

clearance.posture: standing: rays from the capsule's centre at 88 cm. Crouched (half-height 44) is not covered by this proof; crouched and native coverage are root's

crouched_estimate.note: a CPU estimate on the same plan positions and boxes, not root's coverage
